title: Identities & Aliases
summary: Klein's identities, aliases, disguises, and related names.
searchText: Identities & Aliases Characters Klein's identities, aliases, disguises, and related names. This page includes spoilers from across the novels. Klein Moretti 's Identities, Aliases & Disguises 1. The Fool "If I wanted to give you my blessings, I wouldn't have said that. I would have said, I hope that you will still love your family and friends after seeing them as they are." , Klein to Audrey on Lord of Mysteries , Chapter 1228 The Fool is an old god that seeks to revive and reclaim his authority. "He" is mysterious and seems to be executing "His" will through the Tarot Club . "He" does not speak often, especially in later meetings, and only gives hints to Tarot Club members. "He" also does not allow members to offend "Him" and punished Cattleya once she let out hints about "Him" . "He" is the God of the Church of the Fool . A. Appearance After becoming The Fool : "His" facial features are a mix of Klein Moretti and Gehrman Sparrow. "He" wears an illusory mask with blank facial features (uniqueness of the Fool pathway) and wears a black windbreaker. "He" wears a pair of black gloves (uniqueness of the Error pathway) and holds a staff inlaid with star speckles (uniqueness of the Door pathway). 2. Sherlock Moriarty Klein did not take much effort distinguishing Sherlock from Klein, so in many ways, they are similar, except that Sherlock is good at deduction and is a great detective. A. Appearance Sherlock Moriarty has Brown eyes, slightly long black hair, average-featured face with some stubs of facial hair, thin yet with a moderately muscular build. B. Relationship Talim Dumont: Friend, Klein was involved in the case of his death. Mike Joseph: Friend, a reporter who hired Klein as a bodyguard for an investigation. Aaron Ceres: Friend, father of the Will Auceptin . Sharron and Maric : Friend, they helped each other in multiple occasions. Isengard Stanton: Friend, he was one of his connection to the Church of the God of Steam and Machinery. Old Kohler: Worked as Klein's informant in East Borough. Ian Wright: Friend, he was Klein's first client as a detective. Utravsky: Friend, Klein helped him. Emlyn White : Friend C. Reference Sherlock Moriarty. This name is a combination of names from the famous detective Sherlock Holmes and his nemesis, James Moriarty. The fictional characters in the Sherlock Holmes stories written by Sir Arthur Conan Doyle. 3. Gehrman Sparrow/The World He is a crazy adventurer who began to hunt pirates on the sea before being involved in many Beyonders' incidents at the Demigod level. He doesn't talk much, stays cold and calm all the time while being very assertive with others. Gehrman is also known as The World of the Tarot Club , a mad believer and the Angel of Redemption of The Fool. A. Appearance Gehrman Sparrow is a young gentleman with gold-rimmed glasses, neat black hair and dark brown eyes. He looks colder and sharper than Sherlock or Klein. Gehrman refined demeanor and gloomy aura make him appear as an experienced, ruthless adventurer. B. Relationship Blazing Danitz: Servant/Friend/Fool's believer Reinette Tinekerr : Messenger/Ally Edwina Edwards: Ally/Friend Frank Lee: Friend Anderson Hood : Ally/Friend C. Reference Gehrman Sparrow: Gehrman is a reference to Gehrman, the First Hunter, a boss character in Bloodborne. And Captain Jack Sparrow, the protagonist of the Pirate of the Caribbean. 4. Dwayne Dantès Dwayne Dantès is a mysterious tycoon from Desi Bay and a devout believer of Evernight Goddess. He came to Backlund to seek new opportunities, and to a certain extent, tries to enter the upper hierarchy of Backlund nobles. In fact, he was an adventurer who accumulated wealth in the Southern Continent, and since the fortune was not gained in a completely legal way, he came to Backlund to clean up the fortune. If any official Beyonders wish to dig deeper than this, they would then discover that he is a cheat who disguises himself as a rich man and makes big investments for the final scam. He is known as a womanizer because of Arrodes . A. Appearance Dwayne Dantès is a middle-aged gentleman with a mature appearance, deep-blue eyes, black hair with few silver strands, and profound gaze. Someone who exhibits the aura of a person who had experienced the vicissitudes of life. B. Relationship Walter: Butler Richardson: Valet, Land Steward of Maygur Manor Taneja: Housekeeper Maury Macht: Neighbor Portland Moment: Neighbor C. Reference Dwayne Dantès: Dantès is a reference to a famous avenger, Edmond Dantès from The Count of the Monte Cristo, a French adventure novel written in 1844. 5. Merlin Hermes Merlin Hermes: A wandering magician who travels and grants people's wishes. "He" is the creator of the Fully Automatic Wishing Machine, a machine that can supposedly grant its users three wishes. However, it was actually Merlin Hermes granting the wishes. "He" calls himself the Miracle Magician and servant of "The Fool" , Lord of Mysteries, Great Ruler of the Spirit World. A. Appearance Merlin Hermes is a wandering magician, he wears a black robe and classic hat. He looked nothing special. B. Reference Merlin Hermes: Merlin refers to the legendary wizard featured in Arthurian legend. And Hermes is originated from Greek Mythology, who is the Herald of the Gods, Protector of travelers and merchants.

Tarot Club › Klein Moretti Main character profile Klein Moretti The Fool · Lord of Mysteries · Founder and convener of the Tarot Club Klein Moretti is the protagonist of Lord of Mysteries and an important side character in Circle of Inevitability . A modern-era transmigrator living through the identity of Klein Moretti, he becomes The Fool, the ruler above the gray fog, and the founder of the Tarot Club. This page contains major spoilers for Lord of Mysteries and Circle of Inevitability . Profile facts were checked against the linked source articles. Overview Klein is the current owner of Sefirah Castle and holds authority connected to the Fool, Error, and Door Pathways. Through his many identities, he moves between ordinary society, secret organizations, the sea, and the highest levels of the supernatural world. His defining qualities are caution, humor, intelligence, adaptability, and a strong desire to protect the innocent. He repeatedly chooses plans that preserve his humanity even while advancing toward the status of Saint, Angel, God, and finally Lord of Mysteries. Profile snapshot Birth March 4, 1327 of the Fifth Epoch Origin Earth; Southwest China as Zhou Mingrui Current status Alive; resurrected six times according to the source Pathway status Lord of Mysteries; The Fool, Error, and Door authorities Core affiliations Tarot Club; Church of the Fool; Church of the Evernight Goddess Symbol The Pupil-less Eye and the Contorted Lines Biography & historical events The chronology below follows the Klein Moretti/History article and the main Klein Moretti profile. Before the Fifth Epoch: Zhou Mingrui Before becoming Klein Moretti, he was Zhou Mingrui, a hardware engineer from Southwest China in the modern era. He studied a little of many subjects, enjoyed games, and learned Tarot divination while trying to impress someone he liked. After finding an old book titled Quintessential Divination and Arcane Arts of the Qin and Han Dynasty , he performed its Luck Enhancement Ritual and transmigrated in the middle of the night. Tingen City and the Tarot Club The original Klein was a history graduate living in Tingen City with Benson and Melissa Moretti. After Zhou Mingrui fused with his remnants, he joined the Nighthawks as civilian staff and became a Sequence 9 Beyonder of the Fool Pathway. The gray-fog space connected to his transmigration allowed him to draw Audrey Hall and Alger Wilson into his presence, creating the first Tarot Club gathering. Volume 1 — Clown Klein investigated supernatural incidents in Tingen and advanced to Clown. Ince Zangwill's schemes and the True Creator's spawn led to a battle that killed Klein and Dunn Smith. Klein returned to life through the power linked to the gray fog and left for Backlund to become stronger. Volume 2 — Faceless As Sherlock Moriarty, Klein became a detective in Backlund. He survived Rosago's assassination attempt, killed Lanevus while stopping the True Creator's descent, advanced through Magician and Faceless, and escaped a widening conflict involving Ince Zangwill, the royal family, and the Primordial Demoness. Volume 3 — Traveler As Gehrman Sparrow, Klein became a feared adventurer and pirate bounty hunter. He confronted the cult in Bansy Harbor, killed the Sea God Kalvetua in Bayam, worked with Cattleya's crew, advanced to Marionettist, and killed Admiral of Blood Senor. Volume 4 — Undying As Dwayne Dantès, Klein entered Backlund's upper society to pursue the Antigonus Family's Notebook and the Bizarro Sorcerer formula. He survived Foggy Town and Zaratul's trap, explored the undersea ruins with Azik Eggers, and worked with Leonard Mitchell and Daly Simone to kill Ince Zangwill. Volume 5 — Red Priest Klein investigated the Great Smog of Backlund and helped clear Amon's avatars with Arianna, Pallez Zoroast, and Will Auceptin. He opposed King George III's Black Emperor ritual, advanced to Scholar of Yore in the Berserk Sea, and discovered that the palace above the gray fog was Sefirah Castle. Volume 6 — Lightseeker Amon took Klein into the Forsaken Land of the Gods and revealed ancient secrets, including the truth that Earth was a far-future Earth. Klein digested the Scholar of Yore potion, escaped using suicide and resurrection, hunted Kotar, gained the characteristics for Miracle Invoker and Attendant of Mysteries, and led the City of Silver out of the Forsaken Land. Volume 7 — The Hanged Man As Merlin Hermes, Klein fulfilled wishes while digesting the Miracle Invoker potion. He helped seal 0-02, assisted Bernadette with Roselle's final mausoleum, created Utopia for his advancement ritual, escaped Adam's divine kingdom, and killed Zaratul to become a King of Angels. Volume 8 — Fool Klein resisted the awakening will of the Celestial Worthy, accommodated the Fool Uniqueness, and advanced to Sequence 0: The Fool. He defeated Amon inside Sefirah Castle with a supernova, then made preparations with the Evernight Goddess and the Tarot Club before entering slumber. Slumber and Circle of Inevitability Klein released the humans sealed in cocoons inside Sefirah Castle before sleeping with Arrodes. Even while asleep, his aura answered major crises, including Termiboros' descent in Cordu Village and the protection of Lumian Lee. On June 25, 1360, Klein fully awakened, fused with the Celestial Worthy, accommodated Sefirah Castle as The Fool, and later accommodated the Error and Door Uniquenesses. The current source records him as the new Lord of Mysteries and the first Great Old Dominator on Earth. Appearance Zhou Mingrui had short black hair, dark brown eyes, glasses, an unremarkable but refined face, and noticeable eye bags. Klein Moretti's original body had black hair, brown eyes, a thin build, and a scholarly air. As a Fool Pathway Beyonder, he used shapeshifting to create distinct appearances for his identities. Sherlock Moriarty Brown eyes, slightly long black hair, average features, and a thin but moderately muscular build. Gehrman Sparrow Neat black hair, dark brown eyes, gold-rimmed glasses, and a colder, sharper adventurer's presence. Dwayne Dantès A middle-aged gentleman with deep-blue eyes, black hair with silver strands, and a profound gaze. Merlin Hermes A wandering magician in a black robe and classic hat. Personality Klein is cautious, good-natured, humorous, polite, mature, and gentlemanly. He is fundamentally a lover of justice and will act even at personal cost. Dangerous experiences make him more ruthless, confident, and mysterious, but he continues to avoid harming innocent people because he fears both moral compromise and loss of control. He is interested in history and appearance, and his talent for acting existed even before he became a Beyonder. The Acting Method strengthens his ability to imitate roles and identities while preserving a private sense of humanity beneath them. Identities and titles The Fool: ruler above the gray fog and hidden leader of the Tarot Club. The World: the Tarot Club identity used for missions and commissions. Sherlock Moriarty: detective identity in Backlund. Gehrman Sparrow: adventurer and pirate bounty hunter. Dwayne Dantès: wealthy Backlund gentleman and social infiltrator. Merlin Hermes: wandering magician who fulfills wishes. Lord of the Mysteries, Novel Overview A story of secrets, sacrifice, and impossible ascension Step above the gray fog In a world of steam engines, sealed artifacts, ancient gods, and pathways that promise power at the cost of sanity, one ordinary man wakes inside a dead stranger's life. What begins as survival becomes a journey through hidden history, secret identities, and the terrifying price of becoming more than human. “The fool that doesn't belong to this era; the mysterious ruler above the gray fog; the King of Yellow and Black who wields good luck.” Cover: The Mysteries Wiki (Fandom) Introduction Firearms, cannons, battleships, airships, potions, divination, curses, and sealed artifacts: the age of steam is brighter than it looks. Behind every church, newspaper, noble house, and fog-shrouded ritual waits a secret capable of changing the world. Follow Klein Moretti from his first frightened questions to the throne of The Fool, then explore the eight volumes that turn a mystery into a legend. Volume 01 · 213 chapters · Chapters 1–213 Clown June 28 – September 16, 1349 A dead man's identity. A gray fog no one can explain. The first seat at a table of strangers. Klein Moretti wakes in Tingen City and learns that survival means becoming a Beyonder. As a Nighthawk, he follows clues through rituals, nightmares, and church secrets while the first Tarot Club gathering takes shape above the gray fog. Read the Volume 1 guide → Volume 02 · 269 chapters · Chapters 214–482 Faceless September 16, 1349 – New Year 1350 In Backlund, a detective's face is only another kind of mask. Klein becomes Sherlock Moriarty and enters a city where every conspiracy has a respectable front. Between the True Creator, Lanevus, royal ambitions, and the secrets of the Faceless potion, he discovers that identity can be both armor and a weapon. Read the Volume 2 guide → Volume 03 · 250 chapters · Chapters 483–732 Traveler The sea route beyond Backlund The city is behind him. The ocean is full of monsters, pirates, and gods with borrowed names. As Gehrman Sparrow, Klein sails through Bansy Harbor, Bayam, and the Sonia Sea. Every port offers a new bargain: cults, pirates, mermaids, the Sea God Kalvetua, and an adventurer's reputation that becomes harder to separate from the man beneath it. Read the Volume 3 guide → Volume 04 · 214 chapters · Chapters 733–946 Undying Backlund, the Southern Continent, and the Foggy Town A gentleman enters high society carrying a detective's past and an angel's attention. Dwayne Dantès gives Klein access to noble drawing rooms, but wealth cannot hide the war beneath the city. While chasing the Antigonus Family's Notebook, he faces Zaratul, Azik's buried history, and the revenge waiting at the end of Ince Zangwill's trail. Read the Volume 4 guide → Volume 05 · 204 chapters · Chapters 947–1150 Red Priest Backlund's Great Smog and the approaching world war The fog is political, the gods are moving, and every victory reveals a larger battlefield. Klein investigates the Great Smog while Amon's avatars spread through Backlund. His path crosses King George III, Adam, the Evernight Goddess, and the buried truth of Sefirah Castle, transforming a private investigation into a struggle over the shape of history. Read the Volume 5 guide → Volume 06 · 116 chapters · Chapters 1151–1266 Lightseeker The Forsaken Land of the Gods To find a way forward, Klein must walk into a land where even history has been abandoned. Amon's game leads Klein into ancient ruins, lost civilizations, and the truth behind the world he thought he had left. Along the way he hunts Kotar, deepens his bond with Sefirah Castle, and helps the City of Silver search for a future beyond eternal darkness. Read the Volume 6 guide → Volume 07 · 87 chapters · Chapters 1267–1353 The Hanged Man Miracles, wishes, Utopia, and the last preparations A wandering magician grants wishes while quietly building a road toward godhood. As Merlin Hermes, Klein tries to digest his potion through miracles that seem small compared with the coming catastrophe. Utopia, Roselle's final secret, Adam's trap, and Zaratul's last stand pull every thread of his journey tight. Read the Volume 7 guide → Volume 08 · 41 chapters · Chapters 1354–1394 Fool The final step above the gray fog To become The Fool, Klein must gamble with the thing he has spent the whole story protecting: himself. The Celestial Worthy's will awakens as Klein accommodates the Fool Uniqueness and faces Amon inside Sefirah Castle. The final volume is a battle for power, sanity, and identity—and the quiet beginning of the legend that continues into Circle of Inevitability . Read the Volume 8 guide →

title: Church of the Fool
summary: Factions, churches, and organizations in the novel.
searchText: Church of the Fool Organizations Factions, churches, and organizations in the novel. This page includes spoilers from across the novels. Church of the Fool 1. Church Of The Fool "Excuse me sir, do you have a moment to listen about our lord and savior, Mr. Fool?" Baldur on Lord of Mysteries , Chapter 1325 The Church of the Fool, was founded in the year 1352 of the Fifth Epoch after the City of Silver and Moon City residents left the Forsaken Land of the Gods. All the residents believe in The Fool. Aside from those, other believers of The Fool come from some members of the Abraham Family, members of the Tarot Club , members of the Rose School of Thought's Temperance Faction, and the believers of the Church of the Sea God. Their current main church is in New City of Silver in Rorsted Archipelago. The name of the cathedral is The Fool's Cathedral. The Holy Bible, the Order of Mass, and prayer details were written by the City of Silver. It was based on their knowledge of the miracles Mr. Fool had shown, combined with the religious scriptures left behind by the Creator. Some time before the year 1358 of the Fifth Epoch, the Church of the Fool had received acknowledgement by all other Orthodox Churches, and The Fool was officially recognized as an Orthodox God. They don't contain hostility toward other Orthodox Churches. 2. Bible Of The Fool The Fool Across past, present, and future, The Fool reigns supreme over the Spirit World. He is also the King of Yellow and Black who wields good luck. A beacon for all in the pursuit of eternity. He is compassionate, benevolent, and the savior of this world. He allows people to address him as "him" instead of "Him" . He resides above both reality and the Spirit World. His benevolence extends to Heaven and the land. Beside him stand eight angels. Angels of The Fool Angels of Mercury The Angel of Mercury is the embodiment of fate, The Fool's most cherished Angel. Angels of Death The Angel of Death has followed The Fool for the longest period of time and is the consul of the Underworld. Angels of Redemption The Angel of Redemption is the Fool's bugle, once taking on the form of Gehrman Sparrow to deliver his revelations. Angels of Life The Angel of Life is the crystallization of wisdom itself, the indestructible spirituality that resides in everyone’s body. Angels of Retribution The Angel of Retribution is beside the Fool's throne. "He" is the Fool's lightning, the Fool's rage, and the Fool's palm, the judge of all the fallen and the ones who aren't chaste. Angels of Holy Spirit Next to the Angel of Retribution is the Angel of the Holy Spirit, reigning over all spirits and representing The Fool in controlling the Spirit World. Angels of Time The Angel of Time was an angel of ancient times. "He" eventually submitted to The Fool and now strikes the bell of Heaven. Angels of Stars The Angel of Stars is a witness, a recorder, the eyes and ears of The Fool. 3. Sacred Emblem The symbol of the Church of the Fool is The Fool Sacred Emblem. Its the pupil-less eye and contorted lines of mysticism in concealment and change, established during his time of founding the Tarot Club . It is a silver-white Sacred Emblem emitting a radiant glow under the sunlight. The Fool's bible is a black-and-silver patterned book. 4. Prayer Gesture "Praise The Fool!" A concluding words of The Fool believers on Circle of Inevitability, Chapter 291 High Priest Nim of the New Moon City invented the prayer gestures to express their gratitude and devotion to The Fool. They would press the right palm against the left chest, accompanied by spoken: "Praise be to Mr. Fool". As of 1358, the Church of the Fool's customary prayer is to press their hand to their chest and bow slightly. 5. Ten Commandments First commandment: Thou shalt not sacrifice unto me living human sacrifices. Second Commandment: Thou shalt not use my name in vain. Third Commandment: Thou shalt have no other gods before me. Fourth Commandment: Honor thy father, thy mother, and thy children as you love me. Fifth Commandment: Thou shalt not commit adultery. Sixth Commandment: Thou shalt not kill the innocent. Seventh Commandment: Thou shalt not bear false witness, frame, or violate contracts. Eighth Commandment: Serve me with your heart, not with your offerings. Ninth Commandment: Those who have committed lesser wrongdoings, first atone for your sins before seeking forgiveness. Tenth Commandment: Honor my name by helping your compatriots and companions.

title: Tarot Club
summary: Tarot Club lore, rules, members, and commissions.
searchText: Tarot Club Organizations Tarot Club lore, rules, members, and commissions. This page includes spoilers from across the novels. Tarot Club 1. Tarot Club "Our organization's members come from different places and join for different reasons, choosing to change their own faith in the process. As for what happened before that, their lives remain their own." - Dwayne Dantes on Lord of Mysteries , Chapter 853 The Tarot Club is a secret organization founded on June 28, 1349 in the palace above The Gray Fog . It was created by Klein Moretti , known as The Fool , and joined at its founding by Audrey Hall and Alger Wilson . Its headquarters is at Sefirah Castle. Each member takes a tarot card as a codename, and those codenames hold powerful fate over themselves. What began as a private gathering of low-Sequence Beyonders grew into a hidden organization capable of moving the world. 2. Powers As of 1352, all Major Arcana members were Sequence 4 Saints. As of 1359, all Major Arcana members were Sequence 3 or higher and held Sealed Artifacts of all grades, with several Minor Arcana members serving under them. With the Apocalypse in 1360, The Fool and The Chariot both became Great Old Ones. The Chariot left the organization, and The Empress joined in his place. Every Major Arcana member became an Angel. 3. History The Tarot Club started as a gathering of three: Klein Moretti , Audrey Hall , and Alger Wilson . It expanded to 9 members by 1352 and 12 members by 1360. Each member had a different organization backing them, which let the club gather resources from many sources and advance quickly. It first entered the public sphere with the 1349 death of Lanevus, which left tarot cards scattered across the scene. In Spring 1351 the orthodox churches officially recognized it as a powerful secret organization that worships The Fool . The club controls six Cards of Blasphemy : Black Emperor, Tyrant, Red Priest, The Fool, Demoness, and Mother. Mr. Fool has also read the Second Blasphemy Slate. 4. Rules "I am a Fool that likes a fair and equal exchange. You can use what you can attain to exchange with me, or people like you, to exchange for things you want. But remember, they must be equal in value…" - The Fool to The Sun on Lord of Mysteries , Chapter 137 All exchanges have to be fair and equal. Members are not allowed to reveal the existence of the gathering, or the identity of other members. Only The Fool can accept new official members, who hold Major Arcana cards. Those official members can only invite peripheral members, who hold Minor Arcana cards. 5. Gatherings The Tarot Club holds a meeting every Monday at 3:00 in the afternoon, Backlund time, at Sefirah Castle. A gray fog hides each member's appearance, so they do not know one another's faces or identities. Klein translates anything spoken as long as he understands both the speaker's and the listener's languages. The meetings are used to share and sell information, Beyonder ingredients, and artifacts. Members can sacrifice whatever they wish to exchange to The Fool, who grants it to the receiver. Klein also uses the meetings to collect Roselle's Diary entries. After The Fool's sleep in 1352, the members gather on the first Monday afternoon of every month with no convener. "Small Meetings" for Major Arcana members only run monthly until the end of The Fool's dream. In 1359, The Fool partially awakens and again formally conducts the gatherings as convener. 6. Tarot Club in Public The Tarot Club follows a tradition of spreading tarot cards at the scene after completing a task, with its representative card placed prominently. Before the official Beyonders recognized them, the club made itself known in six public cases. The first two were undertaken by Klein Moretti alone. Death of Lanevus: Tarot cards were scattered all over the scene, with The Emperor and Wheel of Fortune on his head. The churches and MI9 were alerted to a possible new secret organization, and rumors spread among the Backlund nobles. Capim's body: The corpse was covered in tarot cards, with Judgment and The Emperor on his face. The press called this appearance the "Hero Bandit Black Emperor". After it, groups like the Aurora Order began investigating clues about The Fool's believers in Backlund. Killing of Jason Beria: The Hero Bandit Black Emperor killed the Desire Apostle Jason Beria, but was interrupted by Leonard Mitchell before the tarot cards could be scattered. Ince Zangwill's corpse: Marked with The Star card. Only the Church of Evernight in West Balam knew about this, as two Nighthawks were directly involved. Ernes Boyar incident: The Moon, The Star, and Justice lured the Sanguine Baron Ernes Boyar to the Harvest Church. When the newspaper he held fell to the ground, the Justice card stuffed within was thrown out. Botis hunt: The Hermit and Justice hunted Botis and left The Hermit card at the scene. After this, the demigods of the churches and MI9 held a conference about the secret organization that used tarot cards as code names, and Leonard officially named it the Tarot Club. "This means that the organization that uses the tarot cards as code names has officially stepped onto the stage of history. Heh heh, please forgive me for using poetic words." - Leonard Mitchell on Lord of Mysteries , Chapter 1202 As of 1358, newspapers and mystical gatherings openly discuss the more active Major Arcana cards. 7. The Fool's Commission "Remember one sentence: the awakening of The World spells The Fool's return." - The Fool on Lord of Mysteries , Chapter 1389 Before The Fool entered his slumber, he entrusted a long-term commission to every member of the Tarot Club. Most of the commissions were completed before the Apocalypse. The common commission for all members except The Chariot, The Empress, and Temperance was to spread The Fool's name widely without clashing with the orthodox churches, and to record that The World is The Fool's Blessed in the Holy Bible. The reward was the convenience they had enjoyed in the past, the responses they received, and help with their future prayers. Member Commission Reward The Hermit ( Cattleya ) Gather information on the Hidden Sage's awakening and state, and watch over her Mother and Moon pathway crew members. A wish. The Sun ( Derrick Berg ) Protect the New City of Silver and New Moon City, protect the Rorsted Archipelago, expand the Church of the Fool , and spread the faith. To become a Blessed. The Magician ( Fors Wall ) Protect the Abraham Family from the temptation of the Cosmos, gather more information on the Fourth Epoch, and write biographies of The World's different identities. The Fool's blessing when advancing to Sequence 2 Planeswalker. The Moon ( Emlyn White ) Gather the blessings given by the Primordial Moon in the Rose School of Thought, form a pharmaceutical company, and spread The Fool's name through it. A wish. Judgement ( Xio Derecha ) Investigate the three Sequence 1 Beyonder characteristics and the Uniqueness of the Red Priest Pathway, and confirm the state of the Primordial Demoness. The Sequence 4 Imperative Mage formula, characteristic, and ingredients, paid in advance. The Star ( Leonard Mitchell ) Gather the blessings given by the Mother Tree of Desire in the Rose School of Thought, share The World's stories in songs and poetry, and raise his Sequence. A wish. Justice ( Audrey Hall ) Assist Judgement in the Red Priest investigation, and raise her Sequence so The World can awaken. The Sequence 3 Dream Weaver characteristic, ingredients, and formula, paid in advance. The Hanged Man ( Alger Wilson ) Bring the Book of Calamity to the Western Continent. The Sea God Scepter, paid in advance. In Book Two, The Magician aids Justice and Judgement in investigating the Iron and Blood Cross Order, with Seven of Wands lending her support. Judgement covertly investigates the Iron and Blood Cross Order and the Demoness Sect, assisted by Two of Cups and Seven of Cups, while Justice aids her with Four of Swords. The revelation of Salinger's Blood Banner, the whereabouts of Vermonda Sauron, and the restoration of Red Angel Medici in Trier let Justice and Judgement fulfill the majority of their commission. 8. Trivia The name "Tarot Club" was initially designated by Audrey Hall when the organization was founded. The members' outside affiliations let the Tarot Club relate to all 22 Standard Pathways . As of Volume 7, Derrick was the only member whose official religion was The Fool. In Volume 8, Alger became the second. Because of The Star, official Beyonder organizations believe that Azik Eggers is a Tarot Club member under the codename Death. Chinese readers call the club Klein's "Rebels Alliance" (二五仔 group), because its members appear devoted to one deity while secretly serving another. Minor Arcana members consider the Major Arcana the true Divine Council. Other churches hold councils under a deity's watchful gaze, but the Tarot Club gathers in the presence of The Fool himself.

title: Tarot Club Achievements

searchText: Tarot Club Achievements Organizations Milestones and achievements of the Tarot Club. This page includes spoilers from across the novels. Tarot Club - Achievements 1. Book One: Lord of Mysteries The achievements of the Tarot Club across Lord of the Mysteries, from the founding gathering to the end of the story. Qilangos The Hanged Man gave the offer to kill the Tyrant Pathway Beyonder Rear Admiral Qilangos in a Tarot meeting. Justice accepted the offer and hired Fors and Xio to investigate him. Later, Justice found him during a ball and prayed to The Fool . Eventually, Azik killed him, while Justice and The Hanged Man assumed it was done by one of Mr. Fool's followers. Steel Maveti The Hanged Man realized that The World was in Bayam, and offered to help. The World then invited him to the fight against Steel Maveti. This was the first time The Hanged Man and The World met in reality. The Hanged Man informed his Church and lured Maveti out, while The World and Danitz conducted the fight and killed him. They split up the bounty. Sea of Ruins The World asked The Hermit for the opportunity to board onto The Future to search for mermaids. They went through a series of adventures along with all the crews and The World advanced to Sequence 5: Marionettist. Primitive Island The Hanged Man gave The World the coordinates of an island he has once explored with Qilangos as the price of the Ocean Songster characteristic. Later, they explored the island together and discovered the painting showing the great betrayal of the three angels: White, Wind and Wisdom. The World 'sacrificed' the Tyrant Card to Mr. Fool . Cielf June The Hanged Man found the artisan Cielf June working with believers of Primordial Moon. He then invited The Hermit to capture Cielf and made him return what was The Hanged Man's and had him hand in all his artifacts. The Hermit then brought Cielf onto The Future to ensure observation and benefits. Ernes Boyar This was the first mission that involved most Tarot Club members. The Moon decided to get revenge against Viscount Ernes Boyar for giving him wrong information about the Abandoned Castle, which almost killed Judgement and The Magician. Judgement investigated and followed Ernes; The Star dragged Ernes into a dream; Justice disguised herself as a paperboy and hypnotized Ernes; The Moon was the bait. The Hanged Man gave his advice that they needed to mislead the Sanguines in some ways. Mr. Fool monitored the whole action above the Gray Fog . Amon Avatars Amon's avatar found Klein in his house, and The Star (with Pallez) came to fight as planned. After defeating Amon, The World brought Justice to Hazel's house to clear her memories about Amon and hypnotized everyone who had been parasitized by Amon to pray to Evernight Goddess afterward. Groselle's Travels The World invited The Star and Justice to explore the subconscious sea of Groselle's Travels. They discovered a non-floating city that exactly resembled the City of Miracle, Liveseyd. At the end they encountered a dangerous corruption locked away by the Dragon of Imagination Ankewelt. Botis The World hired Tarot Club members to hunt Botis in order to obtain his Worms of Star (Worms of Cosmos). The Hermit and Justice hunted Botis together, while Judgement hid aside and interrupted Botis with her Justiciar pathway abilities, The Magician was only a bait and was captured by the Box of the Great Old Ones at the start of the operation. Mr. Fool , as always, monitored the action above the Gray Fog . After the operation The Star 'named' the Tarot Club for the first time. The spoils of war from Botis were divided among the participants. Shaman King Klarman The Moon, along with Rose School of Thought Temperance faction members ( Sharron , Maric , and Reinette Tinekerr ) and The World planned together to hunt down a member of the Rose School of Thought Indulgence faction from the Moon Pathway. Their choice was Shaman King Klarman. The Moon partnered with Sharron to fight, with the help of a Grade 1 Sealed Artifact of the Sun Pathway, while The World and Reinette acted as bait to divert the attention of Suah. In the end, they managed to kill Klarman. Giant King's Court Klein was forced by the True Creator to meet Sasrir. Together with the Sun, Colin Iliad and Lovia, they defeated Sasir and opened the door to the outside world at the cost of the latter two's lives. 2. Book Two: Circle of Inevitability The achievements of the Tarot Club during Circle of Inevitability. Tree of Shadow The Seven of Wands, the Two of Cups, Judgement, and Magician fought and prevented the emergence of the Tree of Shadow, which was planted by the Mother Tree of Desire long ago in Trier. I Know Someone Magician hired Will Auceptin in order to give Jenna enough luck to locate I Know Someone in an asylum in Trier. The Seven of Wands and the Two of Cups fought against him, and with the help of Justice and Magician, they survived and killed him. Fourth Epoch Trier To be added. Sea Prayer Ritual To be added. Loki To be added. Project Vortex To be added. Mr. Fool's Dream To be added. Hunting Hidden Sage To be added. Death of Primordial Demoness To be added.

Cattleya assumes that the Evernight Goddess used the authority of the Moon domain as a bargaining chip after Leonard explains the current situation within the Church of the Evernight Goddess. Fors tells Emlyn that he might become the archbishop of the church or the sole Sanguine representative of the Church of the Earth Mother, to which Leonard explains that Earth Mother will soon have the title of 'Lady of Crimson'. Mr. World tells the others that the focus of the gathering now might switch to exchanging information and engaging in secret cooperation because most of the members have become demigods and their progress in advancement will surely lengthen. Mr. Fool tells everyone that they may now exchange higher level items including the Sea God's identity, level, and strength. Alger asks Mr. Fool what price he needs to pay to exchange these items, to which Mr. Fool answers: "The missions I shall give you, as well as frequent praying and the sincere making of wishes." Mr. Fool gives Alger his current mission of cooperating with the Sea God believers and helping the people from the Forsaken Land of the Gods settle down. Mr. Fool hints on Xio that she could exchange Imperative Mage potion formula and Beyonder characteristic. Audrey receives sincere advice from Alger when she expresses her current feeling of helplessness due to the world situation. Mr. World reminds everyone that the apocalypse will arrive in about a decade and even the deities may perish. The members of the gathering realize that The World has become an angel. Chapters 1320-1323 Â· February 25, 1352 Participants: Klein Moretti , Audrey Hall , Alger Wilson , Derrick Berg , Gehrman Sparrow, Fors Wall , Emlyn White , Cattleya , Leonard Mitchell , and Xio Derecha Fors has become Secrets Sorcerer. Emlyn asks if there was something special about the Planter and Moon pathways that resulted in the internal system of the Church of the Earth Mother. Mr. Fool hints on how some of the 22 Beyonder pathways originated from the original Creator and the Cosmos. Emlyn consults the others as to why the angel level sequence names of the Moon and Planter pathway have certain gender inclinations, to which Audrey hints on the fact that the Witch potion turns the person into a 'witch'. Leonard shares the matters regarding Merlin Hermes and his actions of rebuilding Constant City and performing miracles, to which Mr. World replies that "He'd" be leaving Midseashire soon. This revelation made the others realize that Mr. World was Merlin Hermes. Alger and Cattleya realized "He" was 'acting' to digest "His" potion. Mr. World inquires what the others know about Barros Hopkins to covertly hint on Audrey to bring up the discussion about her experience with the Psychology Alchemists' higher-ups. Audrey shares her experience of being sent to investigate the mind dragon she once encountered two years ago by a secret organization. Emlyn, with his experience in such matters, replies that this should be a test to observe her. Audrey rejected this as she assumes that they already knew she was problematic and she asks for advice on her subsequent actions, to which Alger suggests to stall for time. Audrey asks Mr. Fool if Adam has become Sequence 0, to which Mr. Fool replies "Only with the apocalypse approaching did 'He' finally take that step." Derrick asks how the City of Silver could earn gold pounds and resources. He receives advice on forming mercenary teams, having residents join the industries in Bayam and/or applying for civil jobs within Rorsted Archipelago, and investing in different industries using their liquid funds. Derrick shares that they have built the temple and cathedral meant for Mr. Fool including a Holy Bible, Order of Mass, and prayer details. Alger reminds them to be respectful of Mr. Fool's Oracle and be friendly towards the other churches to avoid conflict. Cattleya inquires about the Sequence 3 Beyonder characteristic of the Mystery Pryer pathway, to which Mr. World suggests she ask Queen Mystic directly, implying that "She" has already advanced and might have an additional spare Clairvoyant Beyonder characteristic. Mr. World commissions a long-term mission to Cattleya to collect information regarding the Hidden Sage's sudden coming back to life, to which the latter agrees. Chapter 1335 Â· 1352 Participants: Klein Moretti , Audrey Hall , Alger Wilson , Derrick Berg , Gehrman Sparrow, Fors Wall , Emlyn White , Cattleya , Leonard Mitchell , and Xio Derecha Klein was undergoing his ritual for Attendant of Mysteries. A gathering was held in Klein's POV: "I sit at the far end of the mottled table and hear Miss Judgment describe the Utopia incident. After she finishes, I look around and hoarsely say, "This is a ritual." Unsurprisingly, I see Miss Judgment's gaze freeze. I can sense Mr. Hanged Man and Miss Justice looking over with a hint of speculation in their eyes. At this moment, I can almost guess what they're thinking. They definitely suspect that this is The World Gehrman Sparrow's Sequence 1 ritual. And they are already long aware from the talks in the Tarot Gatherings that the existence of a Sequence 0 true god makes it impossible for a Sequence 1 to exist. Regarding this matter, I have already prepared an explanation. It is to let them think about the ancient sun god and "His" eight Kings of Angels. Unfortunately, no one raises any questions. They may have already made the connection to the Kings of Angels, or perhaps they believe that the ritual involving Utopia is mainly to help Mr. Fool awaken further. ... I lean back in my chair and listen to The Moon Emlyn describe his dream. After Father Utravsky's appraisal, this dream has been confirmed to have not originated from the Earth Mother. This inevitably makes people cast their looks of suspicion at The Moon, towards a state prior to being corrupted by the Mother Goddess of Depravity... I'm nearly amused by my own thoughts. As an experienced Seer, a master at deciphering dreams, I'm not held back by modesty. I frankly reveal what I know: "The three possibilities are that this dreamscape is trying to bait you into exploring and pursuing something. To a certain extent, it can interfere with your fate. Secondly, this dreamscape hopes that you can interpret it deeply and understand it. Then, through this, corrupt you in an indiscernible manner. Thirdly, you are too worried about the matter of becoming a Beauty Goddess, so you dreamed of that remarkably terrifying scene. "The third possibility doesn't need elaborating on. The action needed for the first two possibilities are the same: don't think about it, don't investigate. There's no need to leave Backlund." With that said, I see Emlyn nod without any hesitation. I know it's his way of handling things. ... Bansy? Verdu wants to go to Bansy? I sit at the bottom end of the long, mottled table and look at The Hanged Man who has reported to Mr. Fool. I have some doubts about the development of the matter. Verdu, who's engrossed in mysticism and is trying to save Mr. Door, does have certain reasons to search Bansy Harbor. Furthermore, he has stayed in Bayam for almost half a year, so it's very normal for him to come into contact with information about Bansy... The main problem is that The Hanged Man's previous surveillance didn't provide any corresponding signs, making Verdu's actions seem a little out of place... The importance placed on this matter has to be raised... I nod inwardly and hear Mr. Fool instruct, "Continue monitoring." - Lord of Mysteries, Chapter 1335 Open volume Chapters 1388-1390 Â· 1352 Participants: Klein Moretti , Audrey Hall , Alger Wilson , Derrick Berg , Fors Wall , Emlyn White , Cattleya , Leonard Mitchell , and Xio Derecha A sudden gathering without prior notice. Klein has become Fool and half-Lord of the Mysteries. The members were surprised, alarmed, and saddened to see that Mr. World was missing from his seat. Mr. Fool explains that this was a last-minute gathering. Mr. Fool explains that "He" will be entering a state of slumbering, that this involves a war that's at the level of 'Above the Sequences' and involves the forthcoming of The Apocalypse. The members were enlightened about the term 'Above the Sequences.' Mr. Fool reveals that "His" Blessed, The World, has entered a deep slumber. Mr. Fool issues a long-term commission to all the members to aid in "His" awakening; the reward is the convenience they have enjoyed in the past, responses they receive, and corresponding help given to them in the future. To spread "His" name more widely without clashing with the Orthodox Churches. To spread the news that The World is "His" Blessed, and record it in the Church's Holy Bible. To remember one sentence: The awakening of The World spells The Fool's return. Mr. Fool explains that after "He" begins "His" slumber, "He" could still respond to their prayers in a certain way, but not every time. Mr. Fool issues each member a mission: To Cattleya , to gather all the information regarding the Hidden Sage suddenly coming to life; if she wishes, she could further investigate the present state of the Hidden Sage. The reward is a wish. To Derrick, to protect the New City of Silver and New Moon City and protect the Rorsted Archipelago and, with this foundation, think about how to expand the Church and spread the faith. The reward is to become "His" Blessed. To Fors, to protect the Abraham Family well to prevent them from suffering the temptation of the cosmos, as well as gather more information regarding the Fourth Epoch and figure out Mr. Door's condition at that time. Uncover some of the latent problems of the Abraham Family. And, if she's willing, she can write down biographies and stories of The World's different identities using different aliases. The reward is that when she can have a chance of becoming a Planeswalker and have to head to the cosmos, she will receive "His" blessings. To Emlyn, to gather blessings, auras, and items given by the Primordial Moon to 'Her' believers in the Rose School of Thought. Apart from participating in the besieging of the Rose School of Thought's mission, to form a pharmaceutical company and perform research on how to mass-produce the medicine with magical effects; its main goal was to spread The Fool's name. The reward will be a wish. To Xio, to rely on the official factions to investigate the whereabouts of the three Sequence 1 Beyonder characteristics and the Uniqueness of the Red Priest pathway. And, if there's a chance, find a clue to confirm the Primordial Demoness's present condition. The reward has been bestowed through holding a ritual and becoming a Sequence 4 Imperative Mage. To Leonard, to share the stories of The World with songs and poetry, and try his best to raise his own level to prepare for the apocalypse. The reward is a wish. To Audrey, to assist Xio and investigate the whereabouts of the Red Priest Pathway's Uniqueness and Sequence 1 Beyonder characteristics, confirming the present state of the Primordial Demoness. The other is to work hard to raise her level, as this could create more opportunities to awaken The World. The reward has been bestowed in the form of Dream Weaver Beyonder Characteristic, corresponding ingredients, and potion formula. To Alger, "You will know what your mission is in time to come." Mr. Fool reminds Cattleya to watch over her subordinates who are Beyonders of the Earth and Moon pathways. Audrey notices that Mr. Fool's humanity seems to have become richer just as "He" is about to enter a deep sleep. Mr. Fool reminds Xio to be careful of Bansy. Mr. Fool says to Leonard to not do too much in promoting "His" name, as he is an official Beyonder of the Church of the Evernight Goddess. Mr. Fool tells Alger that he could use the Sea God Scepter, but all the prayers of the Sea God believers will be transferred to Derrick, pointing directly at "Him". Mr. Fool explains that after the gathering, on the first Monday afternoon of every month, they can still gather here, but there will be no convener. If they need to do a private, mini discussion, pray in advance and wait for a response. Mr. Fool ends the gathering, while the members experience a baffling sense of sorrow. 3. Circle of Inevitability Book Two: meetings after The Fool's partial awakening. Chapter 863 Â· 1359 Participants: Audrey Hall , Alger Wilson , Derrick Berg , Fors Wall , Emlyn White , Cattleya , Leonard Mitchell , and Xio Derecha An emergency meeting held with Mr. Fool's permission. Leonard reveals that the Evernight Goddess reminded him through a dream to pay close attention to Harrison. Cattleya realizes the involvement of Bernadette Gustav in Project Vortex. Chapter 1034 Â· 1359 Participants: Gehrman Sparrow, Audrey Hall , Alger Wilson , Derrick Berg , Fors Wall , Emlyn White , Cattleya , Leonard Mitchell , Xio Derecha , and New Major Arcana: Sharron as well as New Major Arcana: Lumian Lee This meeting was conducted after The Fool achieved an initial state of awakening from The Fool's Dream using the identity of Gehrman Sparrow. Temperance Sharron joins the gathering. The Chariot Lumian Lee joins the gathering. Chapters 1039-1040 Â· 1359 Participants: Audrey Hall , Alger Wilson , Derrick Berg , Fors Wall , Emlyn White , Cattleya , Leonard Mitchell , Xio Derecha , Sharron , and Lumian Lee A small meeting conducted to unify the Major Arcana's understanding of Gehrman Sparrow. Chapters 1072-1074 Â· Spring 1359 Participants: Klein Moretti , Audrey Hall , Alger Wilson , Fors Wall , Cattleya , Leonard Mitchell , Sharron , and Lumian Lee A gathering to divide the spoils of war among the Tarot Club members who participated in Hunting the Hidden Sage. Mr. Fool informs the gathering of the rewards that will go to their allies in the battle. The Uniqueness of the Hidden Sage will go to the God of Steam and Machinery. The Knowledge Emperor Beyonder characteristics containing Sequence 9 to Sequence 1 will go to Bernadette, which is also a reward for her assistance in The Fool's Dream. The Church of the Evernight Goddess will receive the Destined Madness Grade 0 Sealed Artifact and the Beyonder characteristics of Seids, who was corrupted by this Sealed Artifact. Cattleya receives a Sage Beyonder characteristic as a reward for fulfilling her commission from the Fool. Lumian receives the Weather Warlock potion formula and the Grade 0 Sealed Artifact, Post-Apocalyptic Scripture. Fors receives the Grade 0 Sealed Artifact, Solomon's Mask. Mr. Fool considers the death of the Hidden Sage his reward. Alger receives Merumu's Spellbook. Audrey receives a Grade 1 Sealed Artifact formed by a Manipulator Beyonder characteristic. Sharron receives Eye of Omniscience. Leonard receives Creator's Hammer, planning to use it to create a self-playing piano. Several Hermit Pathway Beyonder characteristics are to be given to the members of the Curly-Haired Baboons Research Society who assisted. The remaining Mid- and Low-Sequence Beyonder characteristics and mystical items obtained are split between Seven of Cups, Two of Cups, and the Church of the Fool. Lumian asks why the Hidden Sage came to life because of the Great Mother. Mr. Fool says only that the problem lies in the West Continent. Chapters 1087-1092 Â· 1359 Participants: Klein Moretti , Fors Wall , and Lumian Lee A mini-gathering, owing to only a few members being Angels at this point. Fors asks Mr. Fool to explain godhood. Mr. Fool explains the concepts of True Godhood, Apparent Godhood, and the Vague Conception of Godhood that many people have. Mr. Fool also explains high level concepts, including Above the Sequence, the goals of the Great Old Ones, the Original Creator, the history of the Celestial Worthy of Heaven and Earth for Blessings and God Almighty, the Sefirot, the Pillars, and the theoretical Fourth Pillar. Fors advises Lumian on being an angel, while also revealing her preparations to advance to Key of Stars. She and Lumian worry that her status as a Sequence 1 will make her a target during the Apocalypse. Chapter 1128 Â· 1359 Participants: Klein Moretti , Audrey Hall , Alger Wilson , Derrick Berg , Fors Wall , Emlyn White , Cattleya , Leonard Mitchell , Xio Derecha , and Sharron A small meeting conducted to announce to the other Major Arcana the Chariot Lumian Lee 's intention to devastate the Demoness Sect. Lumian is not present. Mr. Fool instructs Leonard and Derrick to use this battle as an opportunity for advancement to Sequence 2, either through acting or trading for a Beyonder characteristic. Mr. Fool instructs Sharron that Reinette Tinekerr is also to participate. Chapters 1142-1143 Â· 1360 Participants: Klein Moretti , Audrey Hall , Alger Wilson , Derrick Berg , Fors Wall , Emlyn White , Cattleya , Leonard Mitchell , Xio Derecha , Sharron , and Lumian Lee A meeting to divvy up the spoils of war from the Death of Primordial Demoness and the last meeting before The Apocalypse. While Lumian lacks many valuable artifacts to reward the other members for their participation, he promises to aid them whenever they need. The other members see this as more valuable, now that he is a dual-pathway God. Lumian promises to trade Farbauti's Abomination characteristic to Sharron for the Calamity of Crimson. He then offers to trade Calamity of Crimson to Derrick in exchange for Gift of the Land. If he can resolve its issues, he offers it to Audrey, who in turn offers to lend it to Fors, to help with her plan to relocate the Abraham family to another planet. Lumian offers Fors the chance to travel the Special Mirror Worlds he now controls, in exchange for spreading faith in him. He also shares his new honorific name. Lumian proposes his help to Cattleya and Bernadette in digesting their potions. Lumian also tells Leonard to tell Pallez Zoroast that he owes him a favor. Lumian asks Fors to borrow the Box of the Great Old Ones to resolve the issues on its third level. Xio trades Solomon's Mask to Leonard for Pillar of Severity. She also asserts that she won't be switching to the Black Emperor Pathway. Mr. Fool suggests that since the Book of Calamity task assigned to Alger cannot be completed before the Apocalypse, he instead switches to a neighboring pathway to become an angel sooner. He offers characteristics from the Sun Pathway, White Tower Pathway, or Tyrant Pathway in exchange for The Setting Sun Rooster. Alternatively, he suggests shattering and purifying the Setting Sun Rooster to obtain the characteristic for Profane Presbyter. Alger accepts the latter proposal, deciding to finally live up to his Hanged Man codename in full. Emlyn asks for suggestions on digesting his High Summoner potion. Lumian offers to allow himself to be summoned. Mr. Fool congratulates them all on the success of the operation and remarks that there is about a month left before the Apocalypse. He hopes they will all be present at the next Tarot Meeting. Chapter 1179 Â· 1360 Participants: Klein Moretti , Audrey Hall , Alger Wilson , Derrick Berg , Fors Wall , Emlyn White , Cattleya , Leonard Mitchell , Xio Derecha , Sharron , and New Major Arcana: Franca Roland The Empress Franca Roland 's first depicted gathering, although she joined previously. She has replaced Lumian, since he is now a God. At Mr. Fool's request, Fors, with help from the others, recounts how she and the Tarot Club, barring Audrey, Emlyn, and Leonard, visited the planet Lorbath, along with Pallez Zoroast , Hela, Reinette Tinekerr , and Aurore Lee. The natives worship Supernova Dominator, and they met the God of Steam and Machinery, who is interested in the local technology. Mr. Fool listens with a smile and doesn't interrupt. searchText: Tarot Club Rituals Organizations Rituals and procedures associated with the Tarot Club. This page includes spoilers from across the novels. Tarot Club - Rituals "The Fool that doesn't belong to this era; The Mysterious Ruler above the gray fog; The King of Yellow and Black who wields good luck." - The Fool's Honorific Name "With Mr. Fool, rituals aren't tedious and troublesome!" - The Justice on Lord of Mysteries , Chapter 220 The ritual is transcribed in Hermes / Ancient Hermes / Jotun. 1. The Fool's Prayers Praying to The Fool allows direct communication with him. If Klein doesn't have time to hear the prayer immediately, he can listen to it later, because the prayers are stored in Sefirah Castle . Klein compared it to "wireless communication" and "offline messages". Outside meetings, it was the main way of communication of the Tarot Club between members, or an intelligence report to The Fool. "I pray for your attention. I pray for you to listen. .... [REPORT] " 1.1 Formal Ritual A ritual to The Fool based on a modified version of the Luck Enhancement Ritual. First, the ritual can be informal, in an environment that won't be disturbed. Put four brand new candles on an altar, placed on four corners respectively. It's best if they are candles with a sandalwood scent. Put a loaf of white bread near the candle on the top left corner, a bowl of Feynapotter noodles near the candle on the top right corner, paella by the candle on the bottom left corner, and a Desi pie by the candle on the bottom right corner. Use a silver knife to make a sealed spiritual environment. Mix moon flowers, gold mint, slumber flowers, fingered citron, and rock-rose together, then distill it. Extract it for its essential oil, then pour a drop onto each candle. The incantation used is The Fool's Honorific Name, alongside the following prayer based off Klein's first observed ritual: "I pray for your help. I pray for your loving grace. I pray for you to give me a good dream. Moon flower, a herb that belongs to the red moon, please bestow your powers to my incantation. Fingered citron, a herb that belongs to the sun, please bestow your powers to my incantation." "If you have any matters to tend to that leave you unable to attend the gathering on Mondays, conduct the ritual and inform me (The Fool). All you have to do is change the line in the incantation 'I pray for a good dream' with the reason." - The Fool Audrey Hall 's experience: Cleanse one's body before the ritual by bathing in water infused with a few drops of the ritual's essential oil. Leaving the bath with a clean and naked body, put on a robe: white for women and black for men. In the same room, conduct the ritual on an impromptu altar (table). Remember to set up a silver-knife-based sealed spiritual environment for protection, then receive The Fool's verbal answer. 1.2 Impromptu Ritual "You have to use a simple ritual and recite my (honorific) name whenever you return to the City of Silver. I will notify you in advance for future gatherings. You need not pay too much attention to it on other days, nor do you have to avoid anyone. When you receive my notification, isolate yourself within a thousand heartbeats." - The Fool to The Sun This is essentially a response to a prayer. The Fool opted to omit the other steps of the ritual, since it was a plea directed toward "Him". The Tarot Club members habitually follow this ritual version as they participate in more active events. Klein Moretti Version: pray to The Fool without the need of essential oils or burnt herbs to obtain powers. 2. The Fool's Sacrificial and Bestowment Ritual Introduced in Volume 2: Faceless . A "delivery service" ritual to The Fool, based off The Sun's initial sacrifice ritual. It was more theoretical, with advice from Azik Eggers . The ritual uses Sefirah Castle as an "air transport" point for the delivery of energies and objects to it. The sacrifice and bestowment was once inspired by anecdotes of Evernight gifting holy items to "Her" believers. Therefore, The Fool desired to let certain materials enter and leave Sefirah Castle, establishing a trade route. First of all, prepare an altar. There's no need to make it too complicated; it can be very simple and crude, using the dualism method. The only requirement is to engrave or draw "His" symbol, the hidden "Pupil-less Eye" and the mysterious symbol of the partial contorted lines, the same symbol on the back of The Fool's chair. Secondly, follow the normal sacrificial ritual procedure, but there's no need to burn any more additional herbs or apply the holy oil. There's no restriction on time, just chanting The Fool's name is enough. Remember to use ancient Hermes or Jotun to recite this piece of prayer: "Your devoted servant prays for your attention, I pray for you to take his offerings. I pray for you to open the gates to your Kingdom." After finishing the chant, combine the materials that contain spirituality with the natural power created by the incantation, and await The Fool's response for the sacrifice. To receive the object from The Fool using the dualism method, recite: "Your devoted servant prays for your attention, I pray for you to open the gates to your Kingdom. I pray for you to give me strength." The ritual creates an illusory gate above the gray fog, similar to the Door of Summoning (Door of Sacrifice and Bestowment). However, a Sequence 8 Clown's spirituality alone couldn't construct a stable channel, and he could only use Sefirah Castle to complete the sacrifice. Dualistic Ritual Method: place a candle above the drawn symbol or deity-related object. One candle was placed in the altar's middle, representing the performer making the sacrifice. Klein Moretti Version: uses Sefirah Castle as a storage facility during his adventures. Derrick Berg Version: uses a candle engraved with The Fool's secret symbol, and recites the sacrificial ritual incantation without setting up a wall of spirituality. 2.1 Preorder Business Model With Audrey Hall requesting to buy an Artisan fresh made Sealed Artifact through Alger Wilson , The Fool's Sacrificial and Bestowment Ritual was used to allow a Sealed Artifact preorder business across the Tarot Club members. 2.2 Rental Business Model With Fors Wall introducing the Leymano's Travels rental post, The Fool's Sacrificial and Bestowment Ritual was used to allow rental businesses across the Tarot Club members. Leymano's Travels: each rental basically starts at 300 pounds. Every additional day is an additional 50 pounds. And when returning it, the notebook needs to have two additional pages of Beyonder powers than when it was rented out. If there's only one blank page or no blank pages when it's rented, one just needs to fill up the full book (38 pages). If necessary, the specific circumstances of a given time and place also had to be taken into account. Lord of Mysteries is a western fantasy (xuanhuan) web novel written by the Chinese author Cuttlefish That Loves Diving and published on QiDian. At the end of April 2020, the novel finished its eighth and final volume. The web novel was officially translated by CKTalon and published on Webnovel. In April of 2021, Webnovel renamed the title from "Lord of the Mysteries" to "Lord of Mysteries". 2. Awards and Recognitions Ever since its release, the series has achieved wide critical acclaim. In 2020, the series earned the honor of being one of the first 100 Chinese Web Novels to enter into the "Web Novel Category" Collection of the National Library of China. On September 5, 2022, it was winning Best Special award of "Top Ten Annual National IP Selection in 2021" for Fantasy Creative category. As a phenomenon-level fantasy web novel which leads the new trend of "phenomenal" web novel creation.
