Fool Pathway Abilities & Sequences Sequence 9: Seer Traits A Seer's stat points are all allocated into Spirituality, Mind, Intuition, and Interpretation, with very little combat and physical enhancement. Enhanced Memory: Initially, those who drink the Seer potion will gain a slight increase in memory that will continuously improve during potion digestion. This Enhanced Memory grants a Seer the ability to memorize and learn the steps of various Ritualistic Magic and Divination Arts. Spirituality: A Seer's Spirituality will get enhanced upon drinking this potion. Spirit Vision: They can use Spirit Vision to see non-physical things, such as ghosts and specters. They could see the different parts of a Soul, deduce a person's health and emotions through it, and determine if something has a magical aura. They can "see" obstructed objects and "hear" faint footsteps, allowing them to take pre-emptive judgment. However, their visual, auditory, and tactile senses do not have any enhancements. The Spirit Vision of a Seer is enough to barely make out the step of a staircase under their feet in pitch black darkness. The rest of the environment would look like hazy, very blurry grayness. Divination Arts & Ritualistic Magic: They can master all kinds of Divination methods, including astrology, spiritual numbers, and scrying as well as become more learned than a Mystery Pryer when it comes to Ritualistic Magic. Seers don't gain knowledge on how to directly utilize these mystical arts, only the ability and talent to do them at an expert level. Their mastery is dependent on their time of learning. Seers can ignite a candle wick in an instant with Spirituality using friction, facilitating Rituals. It can also be used to burn paper held in one's hand. Danger Intuition: They can intuitively detect danger using their Spirituality. Sequence 8: Clown Traits Physical Enhancement: After advancing into a Clown, they will possess a strong control over their body, making them akin to a master acrobat and circus performer. A Clown has near complete control over their bodily functions and facial expressions. Their face will only show the expressions they wish to show, with the only situations such as extreme shock or pain causing them to show their true feelings, making them the nemesis of Spectators. This also applies to their limbs and other body parts. They can also project their current appearance by calming their mind. Their dexterity and speed become exceptional, while their strength gains a decent increase. These enhancements allow a Clown to commit various feats of acrobatics, such as swinging themselves up by their feet, easily scaling the outsides of buildings or using backflips to very steadily escape from attacks during fights. They gain powerful coordination and a near inhuman sense of balance. A Clown will never lose their balance, barring certain extreme circumstances. Their enhanced coordination allows them to walk over tightropes as if they were flat ground, jump and land on the backrest of a chair without stumbling, while also making them talented with various combat techniques. Spirituality: Their Spirituality gets marginally enhanced. Danger Intuition: The Danger Intuition of a Clown is greatly enhanced, even granting them a short-term form of premonition, though often ambiguous and unclear. They can supernaturally see the appearance of someone (or a group of people) standing behind a door without ever having to open it themselves. This does not rely on Spirit Vision. They can sometimes intuitively predict the next action somebody will take. This can only provide an opportunity to take advantage of as it happens infrequently. Like Divination, this ability is much more reliable when it comes to actions that will cause harm to the Clown. This allows them to often pre-emptively dodge attacks that would be very lethal. New Abilities Paper Daggers: A Clown becomes capable of temporarily turning sheets of paper as hard and sharp as steel, allowing them to throw them as flying daggers or use them as knives. These Paper Daggers that a Clown makes are powerful enough to stick to solid stone and pierce through a Hunter's flesh and bone. Sequence 7: Magician Traits Physical Enhancement: Their hands are more agile and more nimble. Even if they don't have Beyonder powers, as long as they work hard enough, they can become a top magician. Spirit Vision: Their ability to see various spiritual things gets slightly enhanced, but not by much. They are still unable to see the Astral Projection deep in the Ether Body, and as such, are unable to discern whether a target is a Beyonder or not. New Abilities Magicians possess 9 spell-like abilities that they are able to cast at high speeds, without needing to chant or inject Spirituality to activate them. Damage Transfer: So long as a Magician is not dead and can still move their hand, they can Transfer wounds to different areas like arms or legs, turning fatal wounds into minor injuries. Each wound can only be Transferred once. They cannot Transfer damage with objects. They can Transfer the wounds of others. Flaming Jump: A Magician can phase through a fire spark that they had left behind and any flame that existed within 30 meters. The range would increase over time as they digest the potion. During Flaming Jump, Magicians will become immune to ordinary flames. This will last until after they come out of it, after which they must use Flame Controlling for protection. A Pyromaniac's Flames and a Witch's Black Flames are also things they can phase into and be immune to during the teleportation process. This is similar to the Teleportation abilities of a Traveler in that it uses the unique traits of the Spirit World. However, Magicians do not directly enter it. This means Magicians are able to use Flaming Jump inside areas where the connection to the Spirit World is restricted. However, if one's Luck is extremely bad or that section of the Spirit World has issues, there could still be danger. Air Bullet: Magicians can produce air projectiles with power and speed comparable to that of bullets fired from a custom revolver just by snapping their fingers or mimicking a gun sound. The power and speed of their Air Bullets will improve along with the digestion of the potion and the raising of their Sequence. Paper Figurine Substitute: Magicians can transform a Paper Figurine into themselves and swap places with it. It can not only block a fatal blow but also weaken the damage from Curses. This can be used as crude body doubles to fool others into thinking they were there. After using one, the Magician would reappear in a different but nearby location. Flame Controlling: Magicians are able to freely manipulate flames and ignite certain flammable substances within a range of 30 meters with a simple gesture or action. Like their other abilities, the range of manipulation will increase with the digestion of the potion and raising of their Sequence. Once the potion has been completely digested, a Magician could summon a single swirling flame out of thin air. Underwater Breathing: A Magician can create a thin, invisible air pipe which would allow them to breathe freely underwater and seemingly turn into a Murloc. The initial length of this invisible air pipe a Magician could conjure up is exactly 5 meters. As the potion digests, the length of the pipe would increase. Bone Softening: This ability allows a Magician the ability to soften their bones to some degree. This can be used to escape from a variety of different restraints like handcuffs, ropes, and chests. Drawing Paper As Weapons: This is an evolution of the Clown's Paper Daggers. It now allows a Magician to turn paper into a variety of different weapons, such as bats, bricks, canes etc. Illusion Creation: They can influence the environment, creating Illusions with colors, sounds, and smells that would be close to reality, allowing them to pass off the false as true. They can use sound Illusions to secretly transfer their sounds to others. They possess many different ways to interfere with the Spiritual Intuition of a target. In addition, a Magician will attain some minor tricks, but they aren't very practical. These are minor tricks for performing magic, such as the ability to swap the positions of an item in their hand and an item in a pocket. Sequence 6: Faceless Traits They have certain enhancements for Divination and fighting skills. New Abilities Shapeshifting: They can become anyone at any time with their ability to freely mold their body and flesh, enabling them to perfectly mimic their target's face, body, voice, or even smell to some degree. While it is possible for a Faceless to mimic the facial features and body proportions of someone of the opposite gender, they cannot change their actual physical gender. A Faceless's restrictions include height and mass. They cannot mimic the body proportions of an individual that is too disparate in size from their original body. Their new height cannot be more than a head taller or shorter than their original height. There is a limit to the enlargement and shrinkage of the head, legs, arms, bones etc. A Faceless possesses full control over the transformation on their body. They can freely shift the position of their eyes and other facial features around on their face. They can make their face completely featureless, without any eyes, nose, or mouth. They can even create "fake" facial features on their face such as false eyes. They can change their body odor by adjusting the pores on their skin. However they still are unable to change their lower body. Shapeshifting and their bodily control make a Faceless good at acting. They are able to accurately recall the shape and temperament of everyone they know and recognize them no matter how well disguised they may be. The accumulation of the previous potion skills along with Shapeshifting leads to them being good at combat, Tracking, and anti-Tracking. Strengthened Abilities Their previous abilities are enhanced. Flame Controlling, Flaming Jump, and other Beyonder powers had become about 30% stronger. The original power of their Air Bullets and the length of their invisible pipe that enables Underwater Breathing have increased severalfold. The number of times a Faceless can use Paper Figurine Substitutes and Damage Transfer has increased as a result of their Spirituality gain. Sequence 5: Marionettist New Abilities Spirit Body Threads Manipulation: This is the core power of a Marionettist. With it, they are able to perceive and manipulate Spirit Body Threads, from up to 100 meters away. Through manipulating the Spirit Body Threads of an organism, they directly influence the target's Soul Body, Astral Projection, Body of Heart and Mind, and Ether Body. Then, using the Ether Body as a bridge, they can control their target's body. Within the same Sequence level, targets who have been turned into Marionettes are unable to utilize their Resurrection methods to Revive and escape being a Marionette. This includes, but might not be limited to, the Resurrection abilities of the Undying, the Unaging, the Bloody Archduke, the Knight of Misfortune, and the Black Emperor. The Marionette can Resurrect using their original Pathway's abilities; however, they will remain a Marionette. If the Marionette state is lifted and the Marionette dies, the original owner will still not be able to Resurrect. Instead, they will remain a Marionette and continue dying until their Resurrection is fully depleted. Through the changes within the Spirit Body Threads of an individual target, a Marionettist will have the capability to be able to detect the Parasitism caused by a Parasite. By tracing the Spirit Body Threads of a target, a Marionettist can perceive Invisible targets, such as a Shadow Ascetic's Shadow Lurking or a Witch's Invisibility. A Marionettist can also detect other Marionettists' Marionettes. The process of Spirit Body Threads Manipulation can be hard to detect, and only Beyonders with Divination or Prophetic abilities are able to detect it happening. The process of controlling a target's Spirit Body Threads has a limited range of 5-10 meters (depending on potion digestion) and is split into 2 separate phases. The initial phase of control takes between 5 and 20 seconds to achieve, depending on the rate of potion digestion and the potency of their target's Spirit Body. The target's movements and thoughts begin to slow considerably and are often the first sign that they are being controlled. They can still attempt to fight back and can still think and move, but at reduced speed and greater difficulty; this will only increase as the Marionettist deepens the control of their Spirit Body Threads. This process can be interrupted by external stimuli, usually sharp and abrupt pain, both physical and mental. Upon the process being interrupted, the target immediately regains full faculty over both thoughts and physical movement and the Marionettist would have to start the process over from the beginning. The final phase occurs if the first step is not interrupted for around 5 to 2 and a half minutes, which will lead to full transformation of a target into a Marionette. The amount of time needed to turn a target into a Marionette varies according to the potency of their target's Spirit Body and their digestion of their potion. It is not impossible for Beyonders on the Fool Pathway to create Marionettes by forcing others to swallow Beyonder Characteristics raw. The target would fall into losing control madness with unstable Spirituality, making them easy to drag around. Marionette: Akin to a puppet, they are under full control of their Marionettist. They are dead for all intents and purposes, although they still retain a Soul. Apart from superficial surface thoughts, they would not be able to know about the details of their Marionette's previous lives unless it encounters something or someone familiar. Only then will they "remember" details about this familiar place or person. Marionettists are initially limited to 1 Marionette at a time. They can have a maximum of 3 Marionettes at a time after completely digesting their potion. They are still able to control others' Spirit Body Threads, but are unable to fully convert them into Marionettes without exceeding their current limit. Marionettes can speak any languages they had learned when they were alive, even ones that the Marionettist does not currently know. However, the Marionettist doesn't "learn" the language in this manner and will not be able to speak it themselves. The initial maximum range for controlling a Marionette is 100 meters, this goes up to at least 200 meters with digestion of their potion. Marionettists can possess their Marionettes, allowing them to fully experience everything their Marionettes sees and feels. It can use all its original Beyonder powers, consuming its own Spirituality, allowing them to be directed from afar without danger. The Mind Island of Marionettes is lifeless, as they're essentially dead. As a result, Marionettes are immune to Beyonder powers of the Mind Domain and all psychological effects. The Fate of Marionettes are off, eerily still, resembling death. This makes Beyonder powers that can observe Luck and Fate able to help distinguish them from living creatures. When it came to avoiding the negative effects of the Sealed Artifacts, Marionettes were definitely better than Avatars. Marionettes are unable to consume potions for advancements, as their Spirit Bodies are essentially dead. As Marionettes are considered dead, a Spirit Guide can interfere and influence a Marionette; however, at Sequence 4, the core of a Marionette can have a Worm of Spirit inside. Thus, at those stages it also depends on multiple factors like the relative strength of both sides, condition, how much effort is exerted, etc. Strengthened Abilities Marionettists will also receive a 50% or more increase to their Beyonder powers. Air Bullet: Its strength is comparable to a bullet shot from a steam rifle. Sequence 4: Bizarro Sorcerer Traits Spirituality: Their Spirituality has been improved. Divination: Bizarro Sorcerers are able to obtain more information using simple Divination methods such as instantaneous Dream Divination with a flip of a coin. Spirit Vision: The restriction of having to do a corresponding action to activate Spirit Vision is now removed as now they're capable of activating it at will. New Abilities Bestowal: Bizarro Sorcerers can "gift" their Worms of Spirit to their Marionettes allowing those "gifted" to use the Bizarro Sorcerers' Beyonder powers. Initially, Bizarro Sorcerers are only able to split 50 Worms of Spirit from their Mythical Creature Form. This will increase with digestion of their potion. Authorities Fooling: This is one of the two core authorities of the Fool which encompasses the partial authorities over History, Time, Fate, Change, and Concealment with its corresponding symbol of "Blind Stupidity" within the Mind Domain. Its main effect is turning falsehood into reality. History: "They" are able to Fool History, separating the self of one second from the next. This allows "Them" to swap the past, present, or future conditions of "Themselves," making "Their" past become the present and vice versa. Klein Fooled History into swapping "His" past and present condition while in a cage without a fixed "door." The corresponding past state of "Himself" (now as a Historical Projection) was in the cage while "His" present self was outside of it. Time: "They" can Fool Time, confusing the sequence of events, delaying the effects of Beyonder powers as if breaking free from Time's constraints, moving within a frozen environment through various real or conceptual gaps. Unlike the Error's Time authority, the Fool's Fooling Time does not involve operations like speeding up or slowing down Time. Instead, it disrupts the current manifestation of Time, thereby causing operations that require Time to succeed or fail. Klein Fooled Time, confusing its order of events so that Amon's Worms of Time split up at the incorrect timing, allowing Klein to escape. Klein Fooled Time, escaping its limitations to freely move within the frozen environment created by Amon's Time authority. Klein Fooled Time, allowing for the effects of "His" Grafted star to linger even after the combination was dispelled. Change: "They" are able to induce significant Changes and alter the surrounding environment based on certain concepts. Klein Grafted the concept of a "star" (taken from a star in the Cosmos) and used Fooling on the environment in order to change the surrounding area in accordance with the concept of a star. For a falsehood to be turned into truth, it first needs the said falsehood to exist. If "They" were to turn a fictional character into a real person, the character would need to be created first; only then could "They" make it a reality. "They" can use Fooling to make the falsehood real in order to change their own gender from male to female or vice versa. The authority of Fooling, being the symbol of Blind Stupidity within the Mind Domain, overlaps with the Mind authority of the Visionary, capable of influencing the Minds of living beings and exert some effect within the Mind World. Reassembly (Tampering/Grafting): The authority of Reassembly, born from the interplay of the symbols Change and Bizarreness, forms one of the two core authorities of The Fool. "They" can directly Graft physical objects, entities and abstract concepts, including "Themselves," that originally had no connection, producing Inconceivable yet entirely real effects. The authority of Reassembly can directly act on "concepts" and even "authority" itself. The ability, Damage Transfer, is a subordinate and specialized application of Grafting. Once the Conceptual Reassembly is removed, the effects of Reassembled objects would immediately end on the spot. At the level of Lord of Mysteries, Reassembly is a manifestation of Bizarreness symbolism, while at this level, it's the authority of Change. Simply put, one is a Symbolism and the other is a lower-tier authority manifested from the interplay of Bizarreness and Change symbols. Controller of the Spirit World: Unlike the Door Pathway, which primarily utilizes the Spirit World for Travelling, and the Error Pathway, which leverages it for Decryption and influencing the Body of Heart and Mind, the Fool Pathway controls most of the authorities regarding the Spirit World. Thus, "They" can be regarded as a lesser version of the Lord of the Spirit World. Thus, the Fool Pathway can be considered as the core of the Lord of Mysteries Pathways in matters regarding the Spirit World. "They" are not more powerful than Error and Door; "They" are simply the closest to the Lord of Mysteries in terms of authority over the Spirit World. The Fool cannot achieve the effect of Sealing off the Spirit World. Only through merging with the Door can "They" accomplish it to some extent. The Fool, to some extent, is able to command the Seven Lights and Angel-level Spirit World creatures through the Controller of the Spirit World. When fighting within the Spirit World, the Fool has a natural home ground advantage. Whether it is Spirit Body Threads Control or Regeneration, both are merely some applications of the domain's authority; of course, these authorities do not only manifest Spirit World authority, but also involve the lower levels of symbols such as Bizarreness and Change, belonging to composite-type abilities. Puppetry: A lesser authority created by a low manifestation of the symbols of Bizarreness, Change, and the Dominator of the Spirit World. "They" can turn conceptual beings into "Their" Marionettes. This will work even against the Door when "They" are in "Their" Conceptualisation state. Turning the other party's thoughts sluggish during the stage of transforming into a Marionette is a low level performance of the Fooling authority. History: "Their" authority of History formed from the fusion of the symbolisms of the King of Space-Time and Bizarreness. Although the past cannot be altered and History has already been established, the Fool can still manipulate History to a certain extent by temporarily Fooling it. Miracles: The Fool's authority over Miracles belongs to the Inconceivable symbolism, which is also known as Bizarreness. Miracles are 'Unexplainable' and 'Incomprehensible', that is why they are called Miracles. The Fool can reset "Their" Resurrection count once, and the upper limit of "Their" Resurrections has increased. Realm of Mysteries (Concealment): "Their" Divine Kingdom is complete; it arises naturally from the fusion of the symbolisms of Bizarreness and the King of Space-Time. Since the Bizarreness symbol is also known as the Inconceivable symbol, it naturally encompasses the concept of the Incomprehensible, meaning it carries a degree of Concealment. The Concealment elements that are present in the Fool's symbolism originate here, representing a manifestation of Bizarreness. Within the Fool's Divine Kingdom, the Realm of Mysteries, there are various objects Tampered with various effects that make it hard for others to brute force their way into. Klein's Realm of Mysteries contained various doors that were Grafted with many effects. One of them made it so that opening it will cause the target to instantly be Teleported into the sea. Anchor of Destiny: This is an authority under the symbolism of the Beacon of Destiny. The Fate of the Anchor of Destiny is exceedingly difficult to alter, and unless "They" exercise self-restraint, "Their" words will become one of the nodes in the future development of the River of Fate. Whatever "They" say becomes the future, though the manner of its realization and the ultimate outcome may not necessarily be what "They" intended, and could turn out highly Distorted. Shapeshifting: It is one of the authorities that belong to the symbol of Change.

Cuttlefish That Loves Diving Yuan Ye ( 袁野 ) Pen Name: Cuttlefish That Loves Diving A prolific and visionary web novel author from Emeishan City, Sichuan Province . Yuan Ye graduated from the College of Computer Science at Sichuan University in 2007 and became a freelance writer in 2013. Achievements: Member of the China Writers Association | Vice Chairman of Sichuan Writers Association (8th) | Vice Chairman of Sichuan Network Writers Association (1st) His revolutionary works 《Throne of Magical Arcana》 pioneered western fantasy themes in Chinese web fiction, while 《Lord of Mysteries》 set records in the steampunk genre and was permanently collected by the National Library of China . Volume 1: Clown Quote "Everyone will die, including me." , Cuttlefish That Loves Diving on Volume 1: Clown Overview Clown is the first volume of the Lord of Mysteries series written by Cuttlefish That Loves Diving. It details the story of Klein Moretti as he first arrives in the world of Lord of the Mysteries, his becoming a Beyonder and his adventures with the Nighthawks. Title Meaning The meaning of the title Clown refers both to Klein's promotion to Sequence 8 Clown, as well as his inability to withstand the vicissitudes, yet still smiling and continuing along anyway. In this volume, a clown is established to mean those who cannot do anything about their fate, yet continue to smile at it. Despite the many deaths that occur, Klein and the rest of the Nighthawks continue to confront their fates without becoming despondent, fulfilling the meaning of Clown. Synopsis Transmigration In the early morning of June 28, 1349, Klein Moretti committed suicide, leaving a note that read: "Everyone will die, including me." Zhou Mingrui, a history graduate from modern Earth, transmigrates into Klein's body through a Luck Enhancement Ritual, though the inherited memories are incomplete. Discovery of The Gray Fog Attempting to return to Earth through the luck ritual, Klein instead discovers The Gray Fog, a mysterious transcendent space. He accidentally summons two fellow Beyonders above this fog: Audrey Hall and Alger Wilson . Recognizing an opportunity, Klein assumes the mysterious persona of "Mr. Fool" and establishes the Tarot Club as a clandestine gathering for sharing information and trading Beyonder ingredients. Joining the Nighthawks Klein obtains the Antigonus Family's Notebook, which leads him to join the Blackthorn Security Company, a division of the Nighthawks, as civilian staff. He quickly becomes a Beyonder of the Fool Pathway and, through the Acting Method detailed in Roselle's Diary, advances to Sequence 8: Clown under the Church's guidance. Conspiracy and Betrayal During his time with the Nighthawks, Klein experiences a series of unnatural coincidences in rapid succession. Though suspicious, he realizes too late that Ince Zangwill, a mysterious mastermind, has orchestrated everything. Zangwill uses a True Creator's spawn to target Klein with the devastating Sealed Artifact 0-08. Death and Resurrection Klein is killed alongside Nighthawk captain Dunn Smith in the confrontation. However, he mysteriously returns from death. Seeking greater strength and advancement, Klein relocates to Backlund, where he begins his quest for revenge while continuing to strengthen himself through the Fool Pathway.

Volume 2: Faceless Quote "It was the best of times, it was the worst of times." , Charles Dickens Overview Faceless is the second volume of the Lord of Mysteries series. It details Klein Moretti 's arrival in Backlund and his new identity as Sherlock Moriarty. Title Meaning The title Faceless refers to Klein's promotion to sequence 6 Faceless, as well as the faceless people of East Backlund. It also represents Klein's changing identities and masks. Synopsis The Detective Returns Klein arrives in Backlund, the grand capital city, and establishes himself under a new identity: Sherlock Moriarty, a renowned private detective. This new persona allows him to operate in high society and investigate matters that align with his growing power and influence. Unraveling Conspiracies As Sherlock, Klein becomes entangled in various conspiracies and mysteries that plague Backlund. He navigates complex social networks and dangerous intrigue while building his detective career, all while advancing his understanding of the Fool Pathway. Sequence Advancement Through his investigations and encounters with mysterious forces, Klein makes significant progress on his spiritual path. He undergoes the trials necessary for the next sequence promotion, becoming increasingly faceless and enigmatic.

This page includes spoilers from across the novels. Volume 3: Traveler Quote "Every journey has its destination." , Cuttlefish That Loves Diving Overview Traveler is the third volume. Klein leaves Backlund and travels at sea under the identity of Gehrman Sparrow, meeting new friends and hunting pirates. Title Meaning The title refers to Klein's travels across the seas and his encounters with various people and creatures while maintaining his distance as a traveler. Synopsis The Wandering Detective Klein sets sail across the Sonia Sea as Gehrman Sparrow, a wandering sailor and adventurer. This new identity allows him to explore distant lands while maintaining distance from his previous entanglements. Encounters with Pirates and Mysteries During his travels, Klein becomes entangled with pirates, pirate hunters, and various mysterious forces seeking the legendary Cards of Blasphemy. His journeys expose him to dangerous powers and forbidden knowledge that test both his wit and his growing abilities. Spiritual Growth and Promotion Through his maritime adventures and encounters with powerful adversaries, Klein gains valuable experience and spiritual insights. His journey leads to significant promotions along the Fool Pathway and an expanded sphere of influence across the seas.

Volume 8: Fool Quote The Fool walks the path of the extraordinary. , Cuttlefish That Loves Diving Overview Fool is the eighth and final volume of the Lord of Mysteries series. Title Meaning The Fool represents Klein's journey from an ordinary person to an extraordinary being, coming full circle with the card that started it all. Synopsis The Ultimate Confrontation In this concluding volume, Klein faces his ultimate confrontation with the forces that have shaped his destiny. All the mysteries and questions that have haunted him throughout his journey finally reach their resolution. Full Circle The Fool's journey comes full circle as Klein returns to the beginning, but transformed by all he has experienced. The story of the Fool completes its narrative arc in a climactic and unforgettable finale. The End of Mysteries The mysteries of the world reveal their deepest truths, and the Lord of Mysteries' dominion reaches its ultimate expression. The conclusion of the Fool's story marks the end of an era and the beginning of a new world.
